versions.content: CompuScale Value Symbolic Name The value of the Com- puScale Value Symbolic Name of a given CompuScale shall be obtained by tak- ing the values of the following attributes according to the following priority (lower values indicate higher priority): 1. Take the value of symbol if this attribute exists. 2. Take the value of vt if this attribute exists. 3. Take the value of shortLabel if it exists.
